item.description:

item.title: Porting sm64coopdx to Switch and New 3DS: keep the platform boundary small
item.description:
antoinebou12/sm64coopdx-switch-N3DS

★ 3 · 1 forks · Repository created 2026-08-19

GitHub statistics recorded October 20, 2026.

The interesting part of a console port is rarely a single compiler flag. sm64coopdx-switch-N3DS brings the Coop Deluxe engine to two very different handheld targets. The work lives at the platform boundary: graphics, input, audio, threading, and packaging.

This fork builds on the Coop Deluxe Team’s sm64coopdx, which continues djoslin0’s sm64ex-coop. The multiplayer engine and Lua ecosystem are upstream work; the console adapters are the focus here.

item.title: Serilog.Sinks.SentrySDK: connecting structured logs to error reporting
item.description:
antoinebou12/Serilog.Sinks.SentrySDK

★ 2 · 0 forks · Repository created 2023-06-05

GitHub statistics recorded October 20, 2026.

A log line tells you that something happened. An error event becomes useful when it also carries the exception, release, environment, and request context needed to investigate it. Serilog.Sinks.SentrySDK connects those two views.

This project is based on serilog-contrib/serilog-sinks-sentry. Its own GitHub stars measure interest in this repository, not total Serilog or Sentry adoption.

item.title: uml-mcp
item.description:
uml-mcp

Repository · MIT License · Docs · Hosted MCP

uml-mcp is an open-source Model Context Protocol server that generates Mermaid, PlantUML, and Kroki diagrams from natural-language prompts or explicit diagram source. Use it in Cursor (MCP tools) or ChatGPT via a Custom GPT.

Blog write-up: uml-mcp — diagrams from chat.

Features

  • generate_uml and related MCP tools for sequence, class, flow, and deployment sketches
  • Multiple render backends (Mermaid, PlantUML, Kroki)
  • Used across this portfolio blog for inline .mmd + SVG diagrams

Quick start

git clone https://github.com/antoinebou12/uml-mcp.git
cd uml-mcp

Follow the README for Python dependencies and Cursor MCP configuration.

item.title: uml-mcp — UML diagrams from chat via MCP
item.description:
uml-mcp gives an MCP client real diagram tools: an assistant supplies Mermaid, PlantUML, or another supported diagram source, and the server returns rendered output and useful links. The current repository documents five tools and a catalog of roughly 37 Kroki-backed types. Those counts describe the documented interface, not a rendering benchmark. Version française.

item.title: ESP32-7SEG
item.description:
ESP32-7SEG

Repository · MIT License

Firmware for an ESP32 FireBeetle that drives an Adafruit 7-segment display (I2C backpack) and exposes a local web interface for timer modes and WiFi management.

Web interface

The built-in server serves a Timer Control panel in the browser:

  • Stopwatch and Countdown modes
  • Quick presets: 10 Min, 5 Min, 1 Min
  • Manual minutes and seconds fields plus Start
  • Reset WiFi to clear stored credentials when you need to re-provision the device

Hardware

  • ESP32 FireBeetle (v1.0)
  • Adafruit 7-segment display with I2C backpack
  • Breadboard and jumper wires (SCL, SDA, VCC, GND)

Software

  • PlatformIO project; see platformio.ini in the repo for board and library configuration.
  • The repository also includes Android and firmware subprojects for a fuller stack around the same device.

Quick start

git clone https://github.com/antoinebou12/ESP32-7SEG.git
cd ESP32-7SEG

Open the project in PlatformIO (or Arduino IDE with equivalent libraries), build, and flash the ESP32. After boot, check the serial monitor for the device IP address, then open it in a browser on the same network to use the web UI.

Egg-Stuffed Bella Mushrooms with Goat Cheese and Spinach

Category

  • Preparation Time: 1 minutes

  • Total Time: 6 minutes

  • 3 Large bella mushrooms (price: 1.99$)
  • 2 Eggs (price: 0.50$)
  • 100g Goat cheese (price: 1.99$)
  • 1 Handful of spinach (price: 0.50$)
  • Salt (price: 0.01$)
  • Avocado oil (price: 0.01$)

Prices

Instructions

  1. Preheat your pan with avocado oil.
  2. Remove the stems from the mushrooms, place them cap-side down in the pan.
  3. Crack an egg into each mushroom cap.
  4. Season with salt, add spinach around the mushrooms.
  5. Cover and cook until eggs are set.
  6. Crumble goat cheese over the mushrooms and eggs.
  7. Serve hot with sliced avocado.

item.title: PlantUMLApi
item.description:
PlantUMLApi

Python interface with the PlantUML web. PlantUML is a library for generating UML diagrams from a simple text markup language.

PyPlantUML is a simple remote client interface to a PlantUML server using the same custom encoding used by most other PlantUML clients.

This client defaults to the public PlantUML server but can be used against any server.

Installation

To install, run the following command:

pip install plantumlapi

pip install git+https://github.com/antoinebou12/plantumlapi

Command Line Usage

usage: plantuml.py [-h] [-o OUT] [-s SERVER] filename [filename ...]

Generate images from PlantUML defined files using PlantUML server

positional arguments: 
 filename file(s) to generate images from

optional arguments: 
 -h, --help show this help message and exit 
 -o OUT, --out OUT directory to put the files into 
 -s SERVER, --server SERVER 
 server to generate from; defaults to plantuml.com

Usage

from plantumlapi.plantumlapi import PlantUML

# Create a PlantUML object, set the output directory and server
p = PlantUML(url="https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/duml/SyfFKj2rKt3CoKnELR1Io4ZDoSa70000")

# Generate a diagram from a string
p.process("@startuml\nclass Foo\n@enduml")

Docker

docker run -d -p 8080:8080 plantuml/plantuml-server:jetty

from pyplantuml import PlantUML

# Create a PlantUML object, set the output directory and server
p = PlantUML(url="http://localhost:8080/png")

# Generate a diagram from a string
p.process("@startuml\nclass Foo\n@enduml")

item.title: RawAnalyser
item.description:
here

RawAnalyser

RawAnalyser is a simple Python-based tool designed for analyzing raw images. It provides functionality for black and white clipping detection, gamma calculation, and flatness with vignette detection (Algolux).

Prerequisites

You need to have Python 2.7 installed and the following libraries:

  • json
  • time
  • numpy
  • scipy
  • pyqt5
  • argparse
  • argcomplete
  • watchdog
  • logging
  • colorama
  • plotly
  • matplotlib

Usage

  1. Run the RawAnalyser script:
python RawAnalyser.py <pathfolder> <pointfile> --func <clipping,gamma,vignette,histogram,noHist,basic, default all> --bl <black level, default 1024> --vignette <pathvignette>
  1. Start the GUI:
python GUI.py
  1. Check the value of the pixel and the color with the bayer pattern:
python RawPixel.pt input<file> x y --bitdepth <8,10,16,default 16>

Scripts Description

RawAnalyser.py

A script designed for checking black and white level of clipping in a raw image. You need to provide a path to the folder to be checked and a json file with the region of interest and the gray patches.

  • Buying, selling, shorting, and covering stocks in a game
  • Creating, adding to, getting, and deleting watchlists

  • Getting and cancelling pending orders
  • Checking if the game is down
